full_judgment: 19. Such approach of the trial Court cannot be accepted because of the fact that in exhibit "Kha" there being no date as to when the Money Order was returned to the defendant-tenant nor there being any assertion in the defendant's written statement as to when the Money order was returned as such the presumption of return of the Money Order on 13.9.1987 is not sustainable under the law. The defendant having not stated in the written statement about the date of receipt of refused money order and no specific evidence having been adduced to that extent presumption cannot be made on the data of receipt of refused Money Order. The date which has been mentioned in the Money Order Coupon, exhibit "Kha" being the date of refusal on 9.9.1987, it cannot be said that the House Rent Control Case No. 68of 1987 which was filed on 27.9.1987 as filed within fortnight as contemplated in .section 19 of the Premises Rent Control Ordinance I986,. which was the prevailing law at the relevant period.
